fichas.title: Smoke and Heat Extraction Systems
fichas.summary: Overview of natural and mechanical smoke and heat extraction systems, their components, sizing principles, placement and regulatory applications. Natural systems rely on hot air rising and require consideration of effective opening area, wind, air supply openings, opening timing and installation conditions. The page includes an industrial-roof arrangement, fire-hazard classifications and example evaluation tables.
fichas.building_type: Industrial, commercial and other buildings requiring smoke extraction
uses: Remove smoke and heat during fire
Keep escape, rescue and firefighting routes free of smoke
Support firefighting by maintaining a low-smoke layer
Reduce flash-over risk and damage to building components and contents
